name: io.github.robinlidberg-dot/cap-shield
description: Context selection and compression for AI agents - recall measured, not claimed.

environmentVariables.name: CAP_SHIELD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed for the tools that store or retrieve memory, pack data or issue passes. measure_traffic, list_packages, start_sandbox, verify_pass and get_account work without it; start_sandbox gives a 24-hour key for trying memory.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <CAP-Shield API key>. Only needed for the tools that store or retrieve memory, pack data or issue passes; measure_traffic, list_packages, start_sandbox, verify_pass and get_account work without it.
